rounds.notes:
❗POWER❗
 [Threads of Fate](item_cb61612b-9d83-49a9-989d-013bf084fbcb) is extremely useful to soak up extra healing, as it gives mercy very consistent AOE heals which can build up credits super fast. Later on, the AOE damage boost can also help you really squeeze out as much damage from your DPS and Tank without having to focus on purely one. 

❗ITEMS❗
To soak up that sweet, sweet healing cash, buy [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf) and  [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) to squeeze out as much heals as possible, and to compensate for Mercy's low healing. For survivability, it's up to you! I personally like  [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6) since it helps with harsh poke, but  [First Aid Kit](item_0172eaaa-1902-44a3-b989-d12f0f7301da) and  [Field Rations](item_46ae6709-1166-426f-bca3-97a538d3f089) can work well too!

❗PLAYSTYLE❗
Later on, your main method of obtaining cash will be assists via your teams eliminations and your damage boost. However, Early game you have the game presence of an amoeba. Contrary to the build later on, right now you need to focus on soaking up AS MUCH CASH AS POSSIBLE.

round_upgrades.notes: Take if you expect heavy poke or harass (and if you think your team can hit shots)
Take if you expect some of your team getting picked off
Very good for soaking up heals, and the double dmg boost pocket is very helpful later on!

rounds.notes:
❗ITEMS❗
Here is where the defensiveness starts to build up. If you're behind on cash, i recommend focusing on buying weapon power and attack speed to fuel your healing more and try to get back on track, like [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e) to replace the two greens you bought round 1! otherwise, you can buy [Vital-E-Tee](item_b92e6f1d-3aac-4eec-b027-00c8e1529016) to start taking even less damage, 100 armor is a lot, don't underestimate it! Buy both if you can, as [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e) is extremely good to replace or pair with the two greens you bought in round 1. This item will be your bread and butter for cash flow during the midrounds. Sell the two greens if you need, but keep them if you can. Always prioritize  [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e) .

❗PLAYSTYLE❗
Like round 1, here you really wanna focus on getting high healing, but now you can do more risky plays! Resurrects that were slightly too in the open, will be less risky due to your newfound tankiness. Again, its all about money, money, money.

round_upgrades.notes: Very good for soaking up heals, and the double dmg boost pocket is very helpful later on!

rounds.notes:
❗POWER❗
 [Distortion](item_5557e2f2-02df-4eac-8128-0c23b71183b1)  will help your teammates heal themselves, so that you can spend more time pocketing and they spend less time dying! If you're suspicious of your DPS/Tank's ability to hit shots, you can also go  [Protective Beam](item_3f1ef995-8ecc-45fb-8b57-26fdccc21feb) to give them some extra padding while you spend a little extra time boosting them.

❗ITEMS❗
This is the round where you start to tank things out! Flesh out if you want armor or shields. While you can mix them,  [Crusader Hydraulics](item_b64cee07-ca32-405d-987e-868b415bbc09) and [Reinforced Titanium](item_8ebaa7db-aedf-48ed-adc1-318cb46a3214) need one or the other, so unless you're determined that you wont get hit much, I suggest prioritizing either a set of [Vishkar Condensor](item_086a91da-b65d-4047-8fc7-28a992078b1d) and [Reinforced Titanium](item_8ebaa7db-aedf-48ed-adc1-318cb46a3214)  OR  [Vital-E-Tee](item_b92e6f1d-3aac-4eec-b027-00c8e1529016) and  [Crusader Hydraulics](item_b64cee07-ca32-405d-987e-868b415bbc09) depending on if you're taking more weapon damage or ability damage.

If you're extra plump on cash, consider taking [Iron Eyes](item_f16d03a7-f20e-4a1d-a1f6-55863e163c03) if you're taking a lot of critical hits (this is very good with armor since it doesn't need shields to be active like [Reinforced Titanium](item_8ebaa7db-aedf-48ed-adc1-318cb46a3214) ). Another good option is [Ironclad Exhaust Ports](item_2d085fa5-ace6-4fab-9323-b7a06268bcd0) , which can provide extra padding for your GA or Res.

Either way, make sure to grab [Angeleisure Wear](item_00b53ed7-0768-442b-a2c3-8d19608c9391) since it's a good low cost replacement for  [Martian Mender](item_0099632b-4e18-450e-844f-22c40e51bc98) , helping to provide you self healing in addition to your reduced damage.

❗Playstyle❗
Now that you have a plump health bar, this is where you can focus on boosting your team rather than healing! Yep, it's all up to your teammates and other support to sustain! Don't worry though, as [Distortion](item_5557e2f2-02df-4eac-8128-0c23b71183b1) should help keep everyone topped off.

round_upgrades.notes: Very good for soaking up heals, and the double dmg boost pocket is very helpful later on!
Rather than you healing teammates, they can heal themselves now!

rounds.notes:
❗ITEMS❗
Welcome to the pocket life! It's time to pick up  [Chain Evoker](item_812cc89e-feb0-47d0-9e03-9d8e33a80aca) ! With your extra health and your AOE beam capabilities,  [Chain Evoker](item_812cc89e-feb0-47d0-9e03-9d8e33a80aca) is VERY useful to squeeze out as much damage as physically possible, and building up an ult quickly, which can be crucial to a team fight and your survival. This item gives a net extra 20% dmg boost to your team during ult! that's 35% extra damage per hero damage boosted, insane numbers! 

❗PLAYSTYLE❗
You are the pocket. Your left click? Nonexistent, never heard of that. Mercy has only ever had a blue beam and anyone that says otherwise is insane. 

You should only EVER heal your teammates if they're close to half, or if your other support is out of commision. Your wimp and weak healing is not worth losing the massive damage support output.

round_upgrades.notes: The bread and butter of this build. DO NOT SELL
Very good for soaking up heals, and the double dmg boost pocket is very helpful later on!
Rather than you healing teammates, they can heal themselves now!

rounds.notes:
Okay Okay, big price jump, i know. Let me break it down, don't worry. Also, for extra cash and an extra item space, sell [Advanced Nanobiotics](item_26fcf7c9-b81a-4d8e-a459-b515519cb73e) , you aren't a healer anymore.

❗POWERS❗
Renaissance is great to get consistent value from  [Chain Evoker](item_812cc89e-feb0-47d0-9e03-9d8e33a80aca) and reset your position. While yes, you are tanky, you are still a doormat for any DPS or Dive tank, remember Mercy is ALL about movement and positioning, remember your roots. If your team has never heard of the concept of "cover" try going [Protective Beam](item_3f1ef995-8ecc-45fb-8b57-26fdccc21feb) to provide padding, or  [First Responder](item_30a5c70f-e0b5-489a-96ae-900f34c3823d) if for some god forsaken reason they think the only place they can die is in the middle of the battlefield because they think you are an actual mythological Valkyrie.

❗ITEMS❗
 [Martian Mender](item_0099632b-4e18-450e-844f-22c40e51bc98) is your replacement for  [Angeleisure Wear](item_00b53ed7-0768-442b-a2c3-8d19608c9391) . It's unconditional and gives a VERY nice CD reduction. You can pair it with  [Angeleisure Wear](item_00b53ed7-0768-442b-a2c3-8d19608c9391) if you WANT, but I would recommend selling it to buy a more expensive item if you can. If you have enough to buy it,  [Nebula Conduit](item_476b7040-54c9-4f0c-8283-b4407f6809f8) is AMAZING paired with Mercy's sympathetic passive and [Martian Mender](item_0099632b-4e18-450e-844f-22c40e51bc98) . It makes you even MORE tanky and lets you recover health easier. If you're consistently low health anyways, try out [Rustung Von Wilhelm](item_aea17a63-3f55-4f91-8f49-a7793fbc56c4) for the extra critical survivability.

❗IF YOU DO NOT NEED TO BE MORE TANKY❗
Try out [Angelic Acrobatics](item_baad85fc-3da5-43af-ad9d-f17885f59aa5) for more movement! It makes your GA faster and essentially saves you a LOT of downtime on it.  [Resurrection Rangefinder](item_99baffec-51b5-42e4-be61-e29f3de8219f) is great to go for sneaky and EXTREMELY safe resurrects. [Caduceus Ex](item_9e7965ea-2abc-44a7-b042-950c6ad2fce7) is essentially if your team is soaking up SO much damage that you have to baby them. Really only go this if you're getting so insanely focused you need to play back and need the weapon power to heal your team.

❗PLAYSTYLE❗
Risky resurrects are barely risky anymore. You should essentially be tracer with how mobile and sustaining you are. No longer can you be dived, for your PHAT armor/shields makes it next to impossible.

round_upgrades.notes: The better healing option to replace Angeleisure.
Even though this isn't an AP build, 250 Overhealth is VERY nice to prevent a post-res elim on you or the teammate.
If your team needs padding, get this.
Very good for soaking up heals, and the double dmg boost pocket is very helpful later on!
Rather than you healing teammates, they can heal themselves now!
This will help Chain evoker get more consistent mass value as well as allow you to reset positions after a res

rounds.notes:
❗ITEMS❗
Now would be the time to sell [Crusader Hydraulics](item_b64cee07-ca32-405d-987e-868b415bbc09) or  [Reinforced Titanium](item_8ebaa7db-aedf-48ed-adc1-318cb46a3214) if you bought it, you should be healing and tanking enough to where the slight armor/shield and weapon/ability damage change should not be that hurtful with proper positioning and movement. I heavily recommend getting [Resurrection Rangefinder](item_99baffec-51b5-42e4-be61-e29f3de8219f) since by this point, actual damage dealers will STILL be cooking you like a neighborhood pot roast. You are meat, fodder for their cash and ults.

round_upgrades.notes: Very good for soaking up heals, and the double dmg boost pocket is very helpful later on!
Rather than you healing teammates, they can heal themselves now!
This will help Chain evoker get more consistent mass value as well as allow you to reset positions after a res

rounds.notes:
❗GRAND FINALE❗
Okay I'm assuming that if you got to this point, you're either babysitting your team or are going against the most cracked twomad fans in existence. Go ahead and get  [Crepuscular Circle](item_c0b93ed2-b692-44d5-a38a-ce5a63e83cdb) so that you can baby your team even harder, because clearly a whambulance isn't gonna cut it. Another option is [Triage Unit](item_fec0554c-2685-4b93-822d-bf0020e654b4) , but, let's be honest, if your team is depending on healing from a mercy, you're doomed.

❗ITEMS❗
Get anything to make you live longer, probably  [Rustung Von Wilhelm](item_aea17a63-3f55-4f91-8f49-a7793fbc56c4) . Eyeball what it is that's killing you or knocking you out of a fight, and full counter it.
